reference.configuration: US four-funnel flush-deck destroyer reference covering Wickes and Clemson in the Army manual. Four single 4-inch guns and four triple torpedo mounts, with paired wing guns amidships. The catalog Wickes hull is represented by this explicitly shared flush-decker arrangement; builder-specific bridge and stern details vary.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
